correctness.rationale: For every prime \(p\) and \(b\geq2\), the complete endomorphism coordinates and multiplication reduce \(T^2=0\) to \(u=0\), \(z\equiv0\pmod p\) and \(z^2+p^{b-1}vw\equiv0\pmod {p^b}\). For even \(b=2s\), divisibility of \(z\) by \(p^s\) and \(vw=0\) yield exactly \((2p-1)p^s\) operators. For odd \(b=2s+1\), the ordinary \((2p-1)p^s\) operators and cancellation \((p-1)^2p^s\) operators total \(p^{s+2}\). The images of the two generators prove cyclicity and every exact image-order coefficient. The homogeneous case \(b=1\) follows from rank-one square-zero linear maps. Exhaustive computer checks in fourteen finite parameter configurations return VERIFY_OK; finite tests do not replace the general proof.

value.rationale: The natural square-zero condition is the definition of a differential on an additive group. The theorem gives all images and counts on the first nonhomogeneous rank-two p-primary family \(C_p\oplus C_{p^b}\), for every \(p\) and exponent \(b\), not just arbitrary finite examples. Universal cyclicity and an extra top-order stratum exactly for odd \(b\) are structural effects that aggregate endomorphism/automorphism orders do not reveal.
